hazards.evidence: Left wooden handrail terminates in a rounded end cap several treads above the bottom of the flight, leaving the lowest ~2 steps without a graspable rail on that side; the right rail extends closer to the bottom. For a walker user, the rail also does not continue past the bottom nosing.
